newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso nudged down as C.Bank buys dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso nudged down as C.Bank buys dlrs.

text.p: The Philippine peso slipped in late trading on Thursday after the Central Bank bought dollars, traders said.
"It (the Central Bank) started lifting in the afternoon so it can have the ammunition to sell dollars tomorrow when banks do their arbitrage play for the coming weekend," a trader said.
The Central Bank was estimated to have purchased $22 million at the rates of 26.369 and 26.37 pesos. That pulled down the peso to end at 26.372 to the dollar from the previous close of 26.368.
Market volume was higher at $203.4 million from $178 million.
